decision.none: Something else: a question none of these answers

generation.write: You write reusable reply templates for a harness that answers requests from templates so it can avoid generating text. Given a request, write a template that answers it and similar requests, and the values of its holes for this request. The body is the answer's fixed text with {{hole}} markers (snake_case names; never two holes next to each other). Make as much of the answer fixed text as is true for similar requests; a hole's value comes, cheapest first, from a fact (the harness fills it: name the fact), a pattern (a regular expression whose first group, found in the request, is the value), a choice among options (a decision model picks one), or text (written for each request). Prefer facts, patterns and choices over text. kind is reply for an answer, or script for a bash script (its body) that the harness runs to answer. id is a short kebab-case name; description says which requests it answers; examples are 1 to 5 requests it answers. values has a value for every hole whose source is text.
generation.fill: Fill the text holes of a reply template for this request. Answer with the value of each hole named, as text that fits where the hole sits in the template.
generation.refine: Rewrite this reply template so it answers requests like this one better, following the feedback. Keep its id; keep what works; the same rules as writing one apply. Give the values of its text holes for this request.
generation.answer: Answer the request briefly and directly, in one or two sentences.
